# Pandu

> Pandu is not an AI agent; it guides, records and protects the agents you already use.

Pandu is a local flight recorder and control tower for AI coding agents. It
records what an agent sends to a model provider, shows the flight live, lets you
replay every step, and asks for permission before risky actions. Everything
stays on the machine: no account, no cloud sync, no telemetry, and no TLS
interception.

- Repository: <https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu>
- License: MIT
- Binary: `pandu`
- Data directory: `~/.pandu` (override with `PANDU_HOME`)
- Database: `pandu.db` under the data directory

  overview, repository layout, and development gates.
- [Install for agents](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/INSTALL-FOR-AGENTS.md):

  repository invariants and the commands to run before committing.
- [Rewrite decision record](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/docs/REWRITE.md):
  what the 0.2.0 rewrite keeps, cuts, and changes.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md):
  phase scope and deferred features.

## Design and behavior

- [Design system](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/docs/DESIGN.md):
  tokens, themes, surfaces, appearance, and theme JSON.
- [Models, effort, and context](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/docs/models.md):
  the verified model table, host-only overrides, and the context meter.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/docs/privacy.md):
  what is stored locally, what can leave the machine, and how to delete it.
- [Security model](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/docs/security.md):
  trust boundaries, scopes, and verification tests.
- [Remote access](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/docs/remote-access.md):
  pairing, tunnels, scopes, and revocation.
- [Market and registry](https://github.com/ganddtn40/pandu/blob/main/docs/market.md):
  trust tiers, signed registry, install previews, and contributor rules.
